author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನಾತ್ಮ ಶೋಧನೆಗೆ ಸತಿಸುತರು ಜೊತೆಬರರು
ನಿನ್ನೊಳಿಹ ಶಕ್ತಿಗಳೆ ನಿನ್ನಾಪ್ತ ಬಂಧು
ತನ್ನ ದಕ್ಷತೆಯರಿತು ತನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಇಳಿವವನು
ತನ್ನನೇ ಅರಿಯುವನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Wife and children will not come with you on your search for the self;
the powers within you are your closest kin;
one who knows his own ability and goes down within
comes to know himself, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The journey to self-knowledge is a solitary one; even family cannot take it for us. Our inner strengths are our real companions on that path.
